vbetool_global_flags.description: Global flags passed to vbetool if supported (currently empty in standard usage).

subcommand.description: The vbetool subcommand to execute (vbestate, dpms, vbemode, vgamode, post, vgastate, vbefp).

dpms_state.description: The DPMS state to set (on, off, standby, suspend, reduced). Required if subcommand is dpms.

vbestate_action.description: The vbestate action (save or restore). Required if subcommand is vbestate.

vbestate_save_path.description: Path to save the video state. Required if vbestate_action is save.

vbestate_restore_path.description: Path to restore the video state from. Required if vbestate_action is restore.

vbemode_action.description: The vbemode action (get or set). Required if subcommand is vbemode.

vbemode_mode.description: The VESA mode number to set. Required if vbemode_action is set.

vgamode_value.description: The legacy VGA mode number. Required if subcommand is vgamode.

post_romfile.description: Path to a ROM image file for the POST command. Empty string if using system BIOS.

vgastate_state.description: The VGA state to set (on or off). Required if subcommand is vgastate.

vbefp_action.description: The vbefp action (panelid, panelsize, getbrightness, setbrightness, invert). Required if subcommand is vbefp.

vbefp_brightness.description: Brightness level (integer). Required if vbefp_action is setbrightness.
